title: Prompt Engineering Workshop
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners select, order and refine prompt elements to build an AI prompt that generates a sales story for a manufacturing CTO, with feedback on completeness, focus and structure.

learningObjectives: Construct effective AI prompts for story generation by selecting and arranging prompt elements in the correct structure.

controls: custom text input and Add button
reorderable prompt list with arrow and remove buttons

keyQuestions: Construct effective AI prompts for story generation by selecting and arranging prompt elements in the correct structure.
assessmentOpportunities: Final prompt includes persona, industry, insight, structure, tone and at least one specific requirement, with no distractors.
Elements ordered from context through requirements.
